verification.short_circuit: Within each trajectory, decide after two agreeing outcomes (2 of K=3). Across trajectories, KEEP at the first trajectory reaching the target in at least 2/3 reruns.
verification.support_order: Source trajectory first, then every same-rubric trajectory in deterministic topology order; no trajectory-count cap.
verification.target: Each member's own feedback behavioral locus and member-specific intervention; Stage-1 Applicable required, No Match proceeds to the next assigned trajectory.
verification.keep: KEEP when any assigned trajectory reaches the requested outcome change in at least 2/3 reruns; otherwise NOT_VALIDATED only after every applicable assigned trajectory is exhausted.

notes.consolidation: Success and failure strata are independent. The first trajectory in each non-empty stratum always generates. Later trajectories are matched against the current valid bank in batches of at most eight; only unmatched trajectories generate, and pending members are re-matched whenever a valid new rubric is added.
notes.generation_savings: A matched trajectory reuses the unchanged rubric and skips rubric generation and Gate. Matching is performed by the configured rubric-generator model; topic or label similarity alone is insufficient because all matcher checks must pass.
notes.verification: Every trajectory assigned to a newly generated rubric is eligible as a witness. The rubric is kept at the first trajectory with a 2-of-3 target outcome change; if none passes, all applicable assigned trajectories are exhausted before rejection.
notes.unchanged: Agent, Doctor, generator, Gate, scorer, prompts, rollout tree, reward, optimizer, schedule, cumulative scoring scope, and checkpoint behavior are inherited unchanged from train120_max4_direct_luna_v9_1.json.
